jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
ABOUT OPENROUTER

OpenRouter is the leading AI routing and infrastructure layer that developers and enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize their AI use across models and providers. We help our customers avoid lock-in, capacity constraints, and unnecessary cost, giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations deploy leading open and proprietary models  across research, development, and production workloads.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first dedicated Enterprise Product Manager to give the world’s largest organizations access to OpenRouter’s market-leading model catalog while keeping them in control of their policies and costs. Too often, we see employees at enterprises stuck using a single model family and unable to experiment with bleeding edge AI capabilities. To clear the path for these customers, you’ll own a broad product surface: identity and access, governance, security, spend controls, admin tooling, and the growth engine that turns organic adoption into a company-wide deployment.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of product and go-to-market. You'll work closely with Fortune 100 design partners, translating procurement, security, observability, and compliance requirements into a roadmap that unlocks the next tier of enterprise adoption. You'll partner closely with our Enterprise Account Executives, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Customer Success team to convert deal signal into shipped product. We’ll also give you industry-leading tools: our business processes are built from the ground up to be AI-native and we create room for experimentation across the entire model ecosystem to accelerate our own work.

This role is for you if you have moved a product up-market, navigated security reviews and procurement processes, and felt the difference between a feature that demos well and one that closes an enterprise-wide contract. We're looking for someone with high product taste who has built analytics-heavy, technical products and operated inside a true enterprise, sales-led motion.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the enterprise roadmap end to end, from what it takes to get through procurement and security review, to driving daily usage and expansion across the account.

 - Partner directly with Fortune 100 design partners. Turn their requirements into a roadmap, ship against it, and use them as the forcing function for enterprise-grade quality.

 - Build the core enterprise platform: RBAC and granular permissions, SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning, admin and governance controls, org/team management, data privacy and residency, compliance standards, and the spend controls finance and IT expect.

 - Identify opportunities to differentiate OpenRouter for the enterprise by studying emerging trends in AI and making them enterprise-accessible.

 - Drive land-and-expand. Design the product motion that grows one team of developers using OpenRouter into an organization-wide rollout.

 - Be the voice of the enterprise customer internally. Join sales calls and on-site visits; use that signal to ship what will close deals and make our enterprise customers successful.

 - Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, security, and customer success to ship and drive enterprise outcomes.

 - Raise the bar on craft. Bring strong product taste and judgment to a surface where trust, clarity, and details directly determine whether an enterprise fully adopts OpenRouter.



What We're Looking For 

 - 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years building enterprise products, and a track record of moving a product up-market.

 - You've built analytics-heavy, technically deep products with high taste, ideally at a data/analytics or forward-deployed platform serving sophisticated, technical users.

 - You've operated inside a real enterprise, sales-led GTM motion: Fortune 500 customers, multi-stakeholder deals, and the procurement gauntlet that comes with them.

 - Fluency with IT, security, and admin buyer personas. You know what it takes to roll out software at scale and what makes a security team say yes.

 - Hands-on familiarity with enterprise-readiness primitives: RBAC, SSO/SAML, SCIM, audit logs, and governance/compliance.

 - Strong technical judgment. You're comfortable going deep with engineers on infrastructure, APIs, and security tradeoffs.

 - High agency and a bias toward action. You talk to customers, you iterate, you ship, and you thrive in a small, fast-moving environment with intentionally fluid team boundaries.

 - Excellent written communication and a collaborative working style with engineers, designers, and GTM.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience selling into or building for regulated industries (finance, healthcare, public sector) and familiarity with frameworks like SOC 2 and HIPAA.

 - Experience scaling an enterprise motion from early stage to scale at a high-growth company.

 - Familiarity with the AI ecosystem and what enterprises need to deploy it responsibly.



If you don't think you meet all of the criteria above but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
ABOUT OPENROUTER

OpenRouter is the open AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power some of the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise you'll own that journey for our largest and most complex customers, from demo request to signed contract to expansion. You'll set the strategy for and execute enterprise product launches, build the sales narrative and customer proof that help our biggest deals close, and be a true thought partner to Product on packaging and positioning.

You'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Demand Generation, and Field Marketing. This is a hands-on, builder's role on a small team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own enterprise messaging and positioning. Create the core narrative, sales assets, and content that clearly articulate OpenRouter's value to technical and business buyers.

 - Run enterprise launches. Own the strategy and execution for enterprise product launches, from positioning and packaging input through sales readiness, content, and post-launch measurement.

 - Lead competitive enablement. Build and maintain battlecards and positioning frameworks, run win/loss analysis, and deliver sales training that improves performance in strategic deals.

 - Run seller enablement. Work with enablement lead to define what AEs and SEs need to win, keep it current, and measure whether it's working.

 - Support key opportunities directly. Partner with sellers on strategic deals by shaping deal narratives, building custom proof, and joining customer conversations when it helps us win.

 - Build customer programs. Stand up and scale advocacy, case studies, references, and a customer advisory board or design partner program that feeds both our proof and our roadmap.

 - Fuel enterprise campaigns. Partner with Demand Gen and Field Marketing so campaigns reflect real buyer needs, competitive context, and customer proof.

 - Close the loop. Respond to field needs, gather feedback, and continuously improve enablement based on results.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in product marketing or enterprise marketing, with a track record of developing messaging and positioning that sellers actually use.

 - Enterprise PMM experience at an infrastructure, AI, or developer platform company.

 - Experience building a sales narrative from scratch and working closely with AEs and SEs on live deals.

 - Proven experience leading enterprise launches and producing enablement and collateral.

 - Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools and agents to run a high-velocity product marketing and communications program. We'll ask you to show us how you work.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the confidence to engage senior technical and business stakeholders.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping. You'd rather put out a strong v1 this week than a perfect deck next quarter.
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience marketing developer tools, AI-native products, or infrastructure platforms in highly competitive markets.

 - Experience launching or running a customer advisory board or design partner program.

 - A technical background, or enough fluency to demo the product and hold your own with engineers.

 - Experience with a dual self-serve and enterprise motion

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agent Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT OPENROUTER

OpenRouter is the leading AI routing and infrastructure layer that developers and enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize their AI use across models and providers. We help our customers avoid lock-in, capacity constraints, and unnecessary cost, giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

OpenRouter sits at the center of how developers discover, evaluate, integrate, and operate the world’s leading open and proprietary models.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring the first Product Manager for our Agent Platform, named Ori https://openrouter.ai/ori. Ori is our family of tools for putting any model to work in your terminal, in Slack, and on your desktop. Ori’s mission is to promote multi-model adoption at the application layer. Many agent tools today default to a single model family, locking teams in. Ori reflects our belief that the best agent experiences come from model diversity, built upon tools that enable seamless switching.

The Ori team moves fast: a small team built the current product in a few months. You’ll identify the strongest audience for each surface, decide where to focus, and set the goals for how we know it’s working. You’ll balance developers who live in the terminal and notice every detail with teams in Slack who want to teach their interns, agents that work alongside them, without it feeling like engineering. You’ll also ensure our tools are built upon primitives that enable the entire ecosystem to build multi-model apps.

You’ll work day-to-day with a small team led by one of our co-founders, alongside design, go-to-market, and the platform teams Ori is built on. This role is for a builder who has shipped developer tools end-to-end, uses coding agents daily, and wants to take a zero-to-one product from private testing to a business inside a company that already has distribution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the agent platform roadmap end to end across Harness, Code, Eval, Intern, and Desktop, from the CLI today to teams of interns and multi-agent deployments.

 - Set the strategy. Define the target user and competitive positioning for each surface, and decide where Ori should invest across coding, cloud, and desktop agents. Position Ori as an open reference implementation to inspire the multi-model market.

 - Take new tools from waitlist to general availability. Run private testing and design partners, drive internal dogfooding, and instrument adoption, retention, and spend.

 - Make model fungibility real. Model switching, provider fallbacks, guaranteed tool dependencies, org guardrails, and eval-driven model selection that work in any harness and on any surface.

 - Own agent experience, from install and auth to CLI UX, harness configuration, secrets, connections, and the app interfaces. You’ll help us set the quality bar for new consumer-grade experiences.

 - Close the loop with go-to-market and the platform. Turn waitlist, tester, and enterprise signal into the roadmap, and push the API and SDK gaps Ori exposes into the core product.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management or founder experience building developer tools, agent products, or infrastructure for technical users.

 - A zero-to-one track record. You have taken a product from prototype to paying users and are comfortable with the ambiguity and hard tradeoffs that come with it.

 - Daily fluency with coding agents. You use tools like Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenCode and have specific opinions about what makes an agent loop, a harness, or a tool integration good.

 - Strong technical judgment. You read code, run the CLI, inspect traces, and reason with engineers about agent loops, tool calling, context management, evals, and the cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs between models.

 - Strong product taste for developer tools. You’ve shipped technical products where interaction details matter, and can carry that judgment into new interfaces.

 - High agency and a bias toward action. You talk to users, prototype, ship, and iterate on a small team with fluid boundaries. You write clearly and often.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Founder or early employee of a developer tools or agent company.

 - Experience with multi-agent systems, agent skills or memory, or evals and benchmarking products.

 - Experience shipping Slack apps or native desktop apps, or growing a product with both developer and non-developer users.

 - Existing user of OpenRouter or active side projects in AI tooling.
   
   

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria above but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we’re looking for someone excited to join the team.

jobs.title: Product Manager, OpenRouter Connect
jobs.description:
ABOUT OPENROUTER

OpenRouter is the leading AI routing and infrastructure layer that developers and enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize their AI use across models and providers. We help our customers avoid lock-in, capacity constraints, and unnecessary cost, giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve. We provide a single control plane for AI: one place to set policy, manage spend, and track usage, cost, and performance across every model and provider.

OpenRouter sits at the center of how developers and organizations discover, evaluate, integrate, and operate the world’s leading open and proprietary models. Increasingly, that access reaches end users through platforms that use OpenRouter as the managed inference layer for their customers.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring the first Product Manager for OpenRouter Connect. Connect opens a new growth channel by letting partners offer multi-model inference to their customers inside their own products. We’re building a platform for platforms, enabling any company whose customers need inference to integrate and distribute it with the controls and observability that partners and their customers need. Connect is how enterprise and developer tools put the full model catalog in front of their users without building inference, policy enforcement, or usage metering themselves.

You’ll own that surface end to end, working with engineering, design, and our partnerships and go-to-market teams. You’ll spend time with partners, learning what they need to serve their customers and turning that into a roadmap. You’ll own the abstractions that make Connect a product rather than one-off integrations.

This role is for you if you’ve built platform or API products other companies build on, have worked through the identity, policy, and billing questions multi-tenant systems raise, and know the difference between an integration a partner can self-serve in a day and one that stalls.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the Connect roadmap end to end. You’ll own prioritization and requirements definition across partner integration and onboarding, provisioning APIs, controls and guardrails partners need per customer and per end user, and usage visibility and billing.

 - Set the strategy. Determine and prioritize the target partner segments and define the competitive positioning for each. Set the goals for Connect across partner and end user activation, engagement, and retention.

 - Work directly with design partners. Join prospect interest and integration calls, unblock their engineers, and understand partner and end customer needs to determine the roadmap.

 - Work with engineering and design to ship. Make scope and sequencing calls to ship fast, iteratively, and with a high bar of quality and developer experience. Ensure Connect is a set of reusable abstractions, not one-off integrations.

 - Push platform gaps back into the core. When Connect exposes a missing management endpoint, analytics dimension, or guardrail primitive, drive it into the core product so every OpenRouter customer benefits.

 - Shape the commercial model with go-to-market. Partner with our Partnerships and Finance teams on the business model and terms that make Connect a win-win-win for partners, their end customers, and OpenRouter.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management or founder experience building platform, API, or infrastructure products that other companies' engineers build on.

 - You've shipped partner-delivered, multi-tenant products. Another company integrated, white-labeled, or resold what you built (B2B2B or B2B2Dev), and you've worked through the tenant, identity, and billing questions that come with it.

 - A zero-to-one track record. You’ve taken a product from design partners to general availability and are comfortable with the ambiguity, hard tradeoffs, and tight feedback loops that come with it.

 - High agency and a bias toward action. You talk to partners, write specs, ship, and iterate on a fast team with fluid boundaries. You write clearly and often.

 - Strong technical judgment. You read API specs, call the SDKs yourself, review observability and product metrics, and are opinionated about customer facing api surfaces, auth models, partner integrations, usage metering, and tenant isolation.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Time at a developer platform, LLM ops, or AI gateway company, or building the embedded or OEM offering of an infrastructure product.

 - Familiarity with the controls partners’ enterprise customers need, such as access, budget, and DLP management.

 - Experience-informed opinions on tenant isolation, delegated administration, end-user identity, and per-tenant policy.

 - Background in usage-based billing and reporting. You’ve worked on metering, invoicing, or revenue share and understand what finance teams on both sides of a partnership need.

 - Existing user of OpenRouter or hands-on familiarity with the model and provider ecosystem.



If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria above but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we’re looking for someone excited to join the team.
